# Plan

Architecture, contracts and open queue. Evidence: [MEMORY.md](MEMORY.md). Rules: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

## Owners

| Owner | Scope |
| --- | --- |
| Aphrody | Product workflows, application glue, integration and delivery; no duplicated runtime/framework SDK sources |
| Bun fork (`aphrody-labs/bun`) | Precompiled runtime and SDK, Google, Obscura and Tauri capabilities; yolo is absorbed and is no longer an owner |
| Workspace/Infra | Orchestration, inventories, factories, release, hosts |
| Material packages | M3 framework, shared UI and `@aphrody/app-ui`; Aphrody consumes package interfaces |
| Bun fork `bun-python-host` | Pinned native owner of the `aphrody-rust` Python binding; Python applications remain in Aphrody |
| IECODE | Separate repository, store and authority |
| Kernel | `aphrody-kernel`: minimal TCB + subsystems; Linux/Asterinas/kernel32 provide the rest |
| Execution context | Aphrody and Bun can be developed and built on any qualified host/target. Select native, SSH or Docker tools from the current context; local Windows / VPS SSH / DBFR deployment are current environment defaults, not product restrictions. |
| Administration | Yoyo / aphrody-dev administers all Aphrody Labs. Omar administers DBFR; technical access does not imply broader administrative authority (owner correction 2026-10-09). |

## Contracts

- Versioned SDK and C ABI: opaque handles, sized structs, ABI/capability negotiation, length-carrying buffers, allocator-side release, explicit errors, cancellation, threading and lifetime rules.
- Internal Rust types and engine rlibs are not the application ABI; a standard extension builds without rebuilding engines.
- Every context, operation and resource has an owner. Bounded queues, explicit saturation; stop and join workers before unload; respect UI and JS-object threads.
- Permissions, origin and isolation are enforced natively. Remote pages get no implicit Bun/host privilege; cookies and profiles stay isolated.
- Preserve unwind/recovery at real artifact boundaries; isolate work that can fault memory.
- Bun keeps JSC/WebKit, Obscura supplies V8/headless; V8 stays until Obscura/JSC parity. Qualify DOM, GC, exceptions, promises, microtasks, modules, workers, timers, interrupts and teardown.
- Keep API/CLI/permission identities, licences, provenance, features and lockfiles. Remove a replaced path in the batch that qualifies its replacement.
- Engines build per version/target; refuse an incompatible ABI before any native call.
- npm `@aphrody` is the only package channel outside the monorepo; `workspace:*` inside it.
- Select development/build context independently from product capability. Current execution and administrator scope: [execution context](docs/operations/workspace/windows-native.md).
- Aphrody AI is a private server/backend and automation service, never a public product. CLI and authenticated site sessions consume the same capability owners and versioned backend contracts; complete parity includes models, inference, voice, OCR, translation, memory, RAG, training, agents, Document AI, gateway and status when qualified on the execution target. Preserve authorization, streaming, cancellation, errors, session continuity and isolated provider stores. A prompt-only Cloudflare endpoint does not qualify full parity.

| Monorepo consolidation | Aphrody is the product repository. Retire all migrated Google, M3, Obscura and Tauri framework/SDK sources in favor of Bun or Material. Remove duplicate files, packages and legacy directories after consumer gates; preserve unique work, provider stores, assets, licences and provenance. Replace cross-package/repository source imports by package, registry crate or pinned Git interfaces; resolve checkout paths from the current context. Internal module imports remain relative. Runtime, package/artifact and product behavior are qualified separately. |

## Success

- [ ] Changing a workflow, screen or integration does not rebuild engines.
- [ ] A standard Rust extension builds against the light SDK.
- [ ] Every native resource has an owner and a verified teardown; cancellation leaves no leak or dangling callback.
- [ ] Page and extension rights are enforced natively.
- [ ] Runtime and app compatibility, upgrade and rollback are qualified; heavy artifacts are precompiled per supported target.
- [ ] Build, size and memory gains are measured separately; replaced paths are removed after qualification.

Each closure cites revisions, target, commands, results, artifact and limits, and separates source, tests, packaging, installation and activation.
